description: Enhanced typed-literal construction/validation: accepts less-common types and the type-name spelling form, and rejects (type_mismatch) textual values for numeric types, null values for concrete numeric types, and a missing declared type under both the datatype-object and type-name spellings.

cases.expected_output:
op=literal_check
type=int8 form=name status=ok
type=int16 form=name status=ok
type=uint32 form=name status=ok
type=uint64 form=datatype status=ok
type=float32 form=datatype status=ok
type=binary form=name status=ok
type=string form=name status=ok
type=int32 form=datatype status=error error=type_mismatch
type=int8 form=name status=error error=type_mismatch
type=float64 form=datatype status=error error=type_mismatch
type=int32 form=datatype status=error error=type_mismatch
type=int16 form=name status=error error=type_mismatch
type=none form=datatype status=error error=type_mismatch
type=none form=name status=error error=type_mismatch
